title: Message-board post claiming Puharich never died

tellings.quote: was somebody like, I know for a fact that Puharich never died and he was he was taken in by the government and

plain: Around 1995, someone on an online message board claimed to know for a fact that Puharich, the scientist this episode is about, never died, and that the government had taken him in instead. An unnamed researcher tells Michels that they saw the post, quoting it as "I know for a fact that Puharich never died and he was taken in by the government." If it were true, Puharich's official end would be a cover for him going quietly into government work.
